notes.title: 🎉 5th Anniversary Major Update + Community Items Unlocked!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Art & Puzzle Lovers,[/h3][p]We’re celebrating [b]5 amazing years[/b] of [b]WORLD OF ART – JIGSAW PUZZLES[/b] on Steam with our most significant update yet![/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ What's New in the [b]Major Update[/b]:[/h3][list][*][p]✅ Enhanced gameplay experience based on [b]community feedback[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ Improved interface and [b]refined visuals[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ All DLC content [b]revised and upgraded[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✅ General performance improvements and polish[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're a returning fan or a new puzzle enthusiast, now’s the perfect time to experience the peaceful world of art through puzzles.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🏆 [b]GREAT NEWS: Community Items Are Here![/b][/h3][p]We’re proud to announce that WORLD OF ART – JIGSAW PUZZLES now features [b]Steam Community Items[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]🎨 Collectible [b]Trading Cards[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ Beautiful [b]Profile Backgrounds[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💬 Unique [b]Emoticons[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🏅 Craftable [b]Badges[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]These are just the beginning of a new chapter — and we’d love to hear your thoughts![/p][p]👉 [b]Join the discussion and share your feedback in the Community Hub:
[/b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1303670/discussions/0/601914224408619027/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1303670/discussions/0/601914224408619027/[/url][b]

[/b]🙏 Thank You, Community[/p][p]Your reviews, suggestions, and continued passion for the game have helped shape every puzzle and improvement. This update is a [b]tribute to you[/b].[/p][p]From all of us at WORLD OF ART – thank you for being part of this artistic journey.[/p][p]🧩 Let’s keep building something beautiful, one piece at a time.
[/p]

notes.title: WORLD OF ART - a Major Update continues
notes.content:
[b][h1]WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES[/h1][/b]
Major Updates shaped by your feedback, ideas, and support

[b]Dear Fellow Jigsaw Puzzlers,[/b]
This major update is based directly on your reviews, posts, and suggestions – along with a few new ideas developed over time. Every improvement is designed with the intention to make WORLD OF ART – JIGSAW PUZZLES more enjoyable, fair, and flexible for your preferred way of playing.

[b]🎯 Points System Improved[/b]
One of the most important change is completely revised points system, now more accurate and rewarding – especially for players who enjoy large or more challenging puzzles and PixelArt by Numbers.

This updated system applies not only to the main game, but also to:
[b]✔️ 3D DLC
✔️ Jigstris Mode
✔️ PixelArt by Numbers[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/fc76573782182078c6144f507a769510cdcd0534.png[/img]

[b]🖼️ WORLD OF ART – Main Game[/b]
🧩 12 pieces – 1 point
🧩 48 pieces – 7 points
🧩 108 pieces – 25 points
🧩 300 pieces – 150 points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/5ebc7def322d954f1ffd35198321801faeaacb1f.png[/img]

[b]🧠 JIGSTRIS[/b]
🧩 12 pieces – 1 point
🧩 48 pieces – 10 points
🧩 108 pieces – 30 points
🧩 300 pieces – 170 points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/a26eea45b1e6bdea83ba0fb292b104ce6726f384.png[/img]

[b]🎨 PIXELART by NUMBERS[/b]
[b]Easy[/b]
🧩 32 – 170 pts
🧩 64 – 240 pts
🧩 128 – 360 pts
[b]Normal[/b]
🧩 32 – 700 pts
🧩 64 – 900 pts
🧩 128 – 1200 pts
[b]Hard[/b]
🧩 32 – 2000 pts
🧩 64 – 3000 pts
🧩 128 – 4000 pts

Sounds good?

[b]🎨 Visual Options & Interface Improvements[/b]
    Background selection – choose colors and seasonal particle effects.
    Optional shadows – added for better piece visibility.
    General polish to the interface for a more refined experience.

[b]🧱 3D DLC – New Features[/b]
    Optional frame and grid tools added, based on user requests.
    Ability to grab and move multiple pieces at once.
    Customization and performance options for smoother play on a variety of systems.

[b]🔧 Technical Fixes[/b]
    Various bug fixes, UI refinements, and performance improvements.

[b]🖼️ More Puzzles Added[/b]
    Over 100 paintings in the main game for free.
    Over 130 additional puzzles in Upcoming packages coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/552848095fde31c2f6aa0022b2dd364e89dc89ae.jpg[/img]

[b]💬 Share Your Thoughts[/b]
If you find the new system useful, or if something still feels off – feel free to share it. Feedback continues to shape each update and helps guide the direction of future improvements.

[b]⭐ Support Through Reviews ⭐[/b]

[b]WORLD OF ART is approaching its 5th anniversary this June[/b], and the next seasonal update will celebrate that milestone.
If you’ve enjoyed the game so far, consider leaving a Steam review.

[b]Reaching 500 reviews will unlock the next steps:[/b]
Achievements, trading cards, and collectibles can be added – but only with your continued support.

[b]Thank you for being part of WORLD OF ART – and for helping it grow with every piece you place.[/b]

notes.title: WORLD OF ART - A MAJOR UPDATE and DISCOUNT - AUTUMN, WINTER and SPRING 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

There has been a gap in recent updates, caused by serious issues and bumps along the road of independent game development.
Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

[h3][b]WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES is back![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/08c41f7c864a807673b025d02955837fac57c89b.jpg[/img]

The upcoming Spring 2025 Major Update is much bigger than usual.
It includes many new paintings—Autumn, Winter, and Spring 2025, all in one!
There are also [b]new options, features, fixes, and 4 DLCs[/b] coming soon.

[b]The base version of the gallery will exceed 1600 paintings, and the DLCs will bring few hundreds more![/b]
This means a few hundred new puzzles for you to enjoy!


[b]WORLD OF ART needs your support more than ever. If you enjoy the game, please help us grow by:
[list]
[*]     Wishing us on Steam
[*]     Following WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
[*]     Sharing with friends or family who might love the game
[*]     Leaving a review if you haven't already—your feedback means the world!
[/list]
Every action helps us as independent developers, and your support makes a huge difference!

Check out my other games and upcoming titles:
[list]
[*]    The Chess
[*]    The Trial
[*]    SOLCIALISTS
[*]    Project SWARM: DSEP
[*]     ...and a secret FPP project to be revealed soon! 😎
[/list]
Enjoy the update, thanks again for your support!
All the best!


Which season’s puzzles are you most excited to see—Autumn, Winter, or Spring? Let me know in the comments!
